description: Today's AI briefing, or any past day's: top stories with their sources and corroboration labels, emerging signals, new entrants, and regulation updates. Drawn from Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky, arXiv, Hugging Face, lab blogs, tech press in the US, Europe and East Asia, and legislative sources. A curated once-daily synthesis — for raw item-level updates since your last check, use get_new_since instead. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a past day; set top_stories_only for a shorter result.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD for a past briefing (any date in the archive); omit for the latest briefing.

top_stories_only.description: Optional. True returns only the top stories with their sources, leaving out signals, new entrants, movers, regional highlights and regulation. Omit for the whole briefing.

name: get_daily_briefing

provider.description: Attribution: Horizon aggregated this result, and each item also names its own primary source. citation credits both; url is the Horizon page for this result.

url.description: Canonical Horizon page for this result.
